name: tinycc
description: Tiny C Compiler - fast, lightweight C compiler with runtime compilation support

tools.description: Tiny C Compiler for fast C compilation and execution, supports runtime compilation
tools.usage:
tcc hello.c # Compile and run C program directly
tcc -o hello hello.c # Compile to executable
tcc -run hello.c args # Compile and run with arguments
tcc -E hello.c # Preprocess only
tcc -c hello.c # Compile to object file

tools.description: Generate import definition files (.def) from DLL files for TinyCC linking
tools.usage:
tiny_impdef library.dll # Generate .def file from DLL
tiny_impdef -o custom.def library.dll # Custom output filename
tiny_impdef kernel32.dll # Generate Windows API definitions

tools.description: Create static library archives (.lib) from object files for TinyCC
tools.usage:
tiny_libmaker library.lib object1.o object2.o # Create library from objects
tiny_libmaker mylib.lib *.o # Create library from all object files
tiny_libmaker -v library.lib objects/* # Verbose library creation
